title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
abstract: arXiv:2609.37773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. translated_title: OmniVCBench：面向AI虚拟细胞的证据驱动多模态推理基准测试
translated_abstract: 人工智能虚拟细胞被设想为能够模拟细胞响应、解释潜在机制并支持假设驱动科学发现的科学智能体。然而，现有的AIVC基准主要工作在模拟层面，因此有必要对模型如何解读实验证据并构建生物学假说这一能力进行补充性评估。我们提出了OmniVCBench，一个以图表为中心、来源可追溯的基准，专注于评估AIVC的证据解读组件。该基准包含6,077个精心整理的单子图与多子图问答对，均来源于科学文献中的图表和实验背景。在布鲁姆分类法的指导下，我们通过三个科学推理任务，实例化了AIVC“预测—解释—发现”议程在解读层面的对应任务。我们进一步引入了AIVC-Judge，一个任务条件化的“多模态大模型作为评判者”评估框架，配备针对特定类别、基于参考答案的评分准则（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了OmniVCBench——一个包含6,077个问答对、以图表为中心且来源可追溯的基准测试，用于评估AI虚拟细胞对实验证据的解读与科学推理能力，并配套引入了AIVC-Judge这一多模态大模型评判框架。
en_tdlr: OmniVCBench is a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark with 6,077 curated question-answer pairs for evaluating evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in AI Virtual Cells, accompanied by AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge evaluation framework.
